0022600199.text: The Dallas Mavericks, 5-4 and coming off a win, host the Brooklyn Nets, who are 2-7 and have lost their last game, with Dallas 10th in the West and Brooklyn 13th in the East. Dallas will be without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and lists Grant Nelson (knee) as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Mavericks won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 123-114 victory in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026, and this is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season.
